scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:docs
scripts.test: pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__ && pnpm --recursive --if-present test
scripts.validate: pnpm check && pnpm validate:generated && pnpm validate:exports && pnpm validate:boundaries && pnpm validate:semantic-tokens && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm validate:pack-contract
scripts.release:latest: node scripts/verify-release-channel.mjs latest && pnpm --dir packages/ui build && pnpm validate:pack-contract && pnpm release
scripts.release:beta: node scripts/verify-release-channel.mjs beta && pnpm --dir packages/ui build && pnpm validate:pack-contract && changeset publish
